report_name: Veradigm Discloses Third Data Breach, Exposing Patient SSNs

threat_actors.name: The Gentlemen
threat_actors.description: A ransomware group that claimed responsibility for stealing 3.5 million patient records from Veradigm and listed the company on its dark web leak site in September 2026. This claim has not been officially confirmed by Veradigm.

attack_patterns.name: Cloud Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The attacker used stolen credentials from a third-party vendor to access a cloud-hosted, patient-facing API.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: A patient-facing API was abused by an attacker using stolen credentials to systematically exfiltrate sensitive patient data.

attack_patterns.name: Supply Chain Compromise
attack_patterns.description: The attack originated from compromised credentials belonging to a third-party vendor, making it a supply chain attack where the partner's security posture was the weak link.

identities.name: Veradigm
identities.description: A Chicago-based health technology firm that suffered its third data breach in less than two years. An attacker used stolen vendor credentials to access a patient-facing API and exfiltrate personal data, including Social Security numbers.

infrastructure.name: The Gentlemen Dark Web Leak Site
infrastructure.description: A dark web site used by 'The Gentlemen' ransomware group to list Veradigm as a victim and claim the theft of 3.5 million patient records.

indicators.name: High Volume Patient API Lookup
indicators.pattern:
title: High Volume Patient API Lookup
id: 9b8c2d1e-a3f4-4b5c-8d6e-f7a8b9c0d1e2
status: experimental
description: Detects an unusually high volume of requests to the patient lookup API endpoint from a single source, which may indicate automated data scraping.
references:
  - https://shattered.io/veradigm-third-breach-2026-vendor-api-ssn-exposed/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-10
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.collection
level: medium
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-uri-stem|endswith: '/api/patient/lookup'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects access to the patient lookup API endpoint, which was abused in the Veradigm breach. This activity should be correlated to detect high-volume requests indicative of data scraping.

indicators.name: Successful Vendor Cloud Account Login
indicators.pattern:
title: Successful Vendor Cloud Account Login
id: f4a3b2c1-d5e6-4f7a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c
status: experimental
description: Detects a successful login from a vendor or external cloud account. This activity should be monitored for unusual patterns, such as logins from new geographic locations or at odd hours, which could indicate credential theft as seen in the Veradigm breach.
references:
  - https://shattered.io/veradigm-third-breach-2026-vendor-api-ssn-exposed/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-10
tags:
  - attack.t1078.004
  - attack.initial_access
level: low
logsource:
  product: azure
  service: signinlogs
detection:
  selection:
    ResultType: 0
    UserPrincipalName|contains: '#EXT#'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects successful logins from external or vendor cloud accounts. The Veradigm breach was initiated using stolen vendor credentials, making monitoring of such accounts critical.

relationships.target_name: The Gentlemen Dark Web Leak Site
